description: Land Title Settlement Department - Puttalam, Puttalam D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410111 and Other Land Parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act, dealing specifically with land ownership, possession, and interest claims. It involves land registrations, title determinations, and property matters across multiple districts, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
